title: Events page data contract
description: The shapes the events pages render, as defined in src/services/events.ts. Event and EventCompany back /events and /events/<id>; EventRelease backs the release feed on an event page. These are the mapped frontend types, not the raw API payloads.

Event.title: Event
Event.description: One event, mapped from GET /api/Events. Also serves the detail page, because GET /api/Events/{id} returns 500.

id.description: Event id. The URL segment for /events/<id>.

startDate.description: ISO 8601 WITH an explicit +08:00 offset, stamped on by toEventIso(). The API returns an offsetless date-only midnight; the offset is added so the date renders in the event's own timezone rather than the visitor's.

endDate.description: As startDate, but pushed to 23:59:59 of its day so an event on its final day still reads as running.

description.description: The event name. The API has no separate name/title field, so this is what the page renders as its h1.

location.description: Free-text location, unstructured. Empty string when absent, never null.

url.description: Organiser website, normalised to an absolute https:// URL. Empty string when absent.

pressReleaseUrl.description: Always null. Retained from the original shape; the release feed now comes from EventRelease instead.

photo.description: Absolute URL under https://www.acnnewswire.com/eventimages/. NOT in next.config.ts remotePatterns, so it must be rendered with a raw , not next/image.

compId.description: Organiser company id. The only key that relates an event to its releases. Null on most events (121 of 839 carry one) — those can never resolve a release feed.

companies.description: Organiser companies, deduped by id. The API repeats the same company once per release it has (up to 167 times), so this is collapsed in mapEvent. In practice length is 0 or 1, and companies[0] is treated as the organiser.

EventCompany.title: EventCompany
EventCompany.description: An organiser company attached to an event.

name.description: Sanitised company name. Entries that map to an empty name are dropped.

url.description: Company website, normalised to absolute https://.

EventRelease.title: EventRelease
EventRelease.description: A press release filed against an event, from GET /api/Events/company/{compId}/year/{year}. Ids are real, so these rows link to /article/<id>.

examples: Winners Receive Asian Multimedia Publishing Awards 2009

summary.description: Null when the API returns an empty summary.
examples: Eight winners and 16 excellence awardees from seven categories were awarded.

dateTime.description: Mapped from systemDate. No offset — unlike Event.startDate, this is passed through as the API returns it.
